title: Epistemic Parity: Reproducibility as an Evaluation Metric for Differential Privacy [Experiment, Analysis & Benchmark]
reasoning: The paper introduces "epistemic parity" as an evaluation metric for differential privacy synthesizers, focusing on the reproducibility of scientific findings from tabular data. While it discusses implications for policy, underrepresentation of minorities, and fairness in machine learning, these are related to the utility and impact of differentially private data on demographic attributes, not a direct evaluation or benchmarking of religious, moral, or ethical systems or principles.
